description: Full European Medicines Agency (EMA) herbal-inventory record for one plant/herb, looked up by Latin name or English common name, plus the direct links to its EU herbal monograph PDF and assessment-report PDF scraped from the herb's EMA page. Returns botanical name(s), therapeutic areas, assessment status, outcome, and dates. Answers "what is the EMA monograph link for valerian root", "get the EU assessment report for ginkgo leaf", "EMA record for Hamamelis virginiana".

common_name.description: English common name, e.g. "Valerian Root". Use if latin_name is not known.

name: herb
